a: Nights on the Calar Alto 2.2-m and 3.5-m telescopes in visitor or service mode for semester 27A. Typically up to 5% of the open time may go to non-partner PIs. No funding.
dt: Deadline 14 Oct 2026, 14:00:00 UT; submissions accepted from 16 Sep 2026. Observing period 1 Jan to 30 Jun 2027.
e: Open call for the two main Calar Alto telescopes in Spain. Open time is mainly for Spain-based PIs. PIs at non-Spanish institutions may apply, but get time only if the CAHA TAC rates them extremely well, and they must justify having no access to a similar instrument at their own facilities.
f: CAHA (Centro Astronómico Hispano en Andalucía; CSIC / Junta de Andalucía)
n: Calar Alto Observatory 2.2-m and 3.5-m Call for Proposals, Semester 27A
unv: Taken off the Astronomy page on Oct 3, 2026: PIs outside Spain must justify having no access to a similar instrument at home, so the call does not meet the telescope-time rule.
